title: Manchester orb sized at 24 inches at most

tellings.quote: We did very detailed analysis 3D recreation of this thing from this exact viewpoints and using the the data there at the most 24 in.

plain: An orb filmed at Manchester Airport in England in 2024 was at most 24 inches across, according to the researcher and UFO skeptic Mick West. He tells Michels that his team made a very detailed 3D recreation of the object from the exact viewpoints of the footage, used the data they had, and arrived at that size. If he is right, the object was something small, not a large craft.
